description.default: One agent tool, exec: call any MCP tool or kernel tool the binary-safe way. Text results come back verbatim; binary results (images, audio, video, files) are saved into assets/mcp and only their paths are returned, so base64 blobs never flood the conversation. {{file2b64.…}} placeholders expand workspace asset bytes into tool arguments.
description.zh_CN: 为思源 Agent 提供一个工具 exec：以二进制安全的方式调用 MCP 工具或内核工具。文本结果原样返回；二进制结果（图片/音频/视频/文件）落盘到 assets/mcp，只返回路径和元数据，base64 不再灌进对话。参数中的 {{file2b64.…}} 占位符可把工作空间附件以 base64 展开进工具参数。
